places.place_tip: Enjoy a leisurely walk or sit by the sea.
places.address: Marine Drive, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

places.name: Elephanta Caves
places.ai_summary: A network of sculpted caves on Elephanta Island, featuring Hindu deities and symbols.
places.cost: ₹ 600 for Indians, ₹ 1,200 for foreigners (includes ferry ride)

opening_hours.notes: Ferry rides start at 09:00 AM. Closed on Mondays.

attribution.description: The Flag of India. The colours are saffron, white and green. The navy blue wheel in the center of the flag has a diameter approximately the width of the white band and is called Ashoka's Dharma Chakra, with 24 spokes (after Ashoka, the Great). Each spoke depicts one hour of the day, portraying the prevalence of righteousness all 24 hours of it.
